architecture: 8 input channels -> width32, 2 context self-attention layers, 4 heads; query cross-attention; softmax2
psd_details: 4 spectral kernels per layer, Gaussian on learned Fourier/time embeddings, trace-normalized PSD metric, convex head fusion, symmetric reference-context normalization
channels: 5 normalized features, observed response (query zero), response-available mask, relative month
objective: KRR squared query error only, no direct weight supervision
controls: same full128 contexts, training/validation episodes, frozen kernels, ridge, and mean query loss; independent training per seed
optimizer: Adam; transformer/summary lr .001, constant lr .01; gradient norm clip1; no dropout
selection: best independent validation KRR loss, patience stopping; evaluation streams excluded
inference: query-dependent alpha, same alpha for local Gram and cross-vector; no inference optimization
limitations: Synthetic task family shared between meta-training and evaluation
No exact preservation constraint for stable borrowers
Each query defines a local PSD kernel, not one global Gram across differently gated queries
